'''2022 MPC Top 8 Mike Kessling DS Map''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessling]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me|V8-D-iwantthatmap.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open I Want That Map Kessling DS 2022.txt |Download]]
